name: NeXgen
description: The NeXgen engine for OpenClaw: the guardrail before a tool call, the vault briefing after a compaction, the /quota, /spend, /council and /sup commands, the supervision tools the supervisor agent drives, the evidence check on local models, and a notice when the Skill Workshop learns a skill. The policy lives in nexgen-guardrail.config.json and, from this release, in plugins.entries.nexgen.config, which OpenClaw hands to the plugin as api.pluginConfig; nexgen.config.json is still read for one release.
